description: Core CSS design system and base.html. Rewrite static/css/main.css with dark glass CSS variables and all global styles (buttons, forms, badges, tables, toasts, modals, cards, pagination, error pages, layout). Update templates/base.html to load Inter font, marked.js CDN, all CSS files, keep CSRF meta tag, remove favicon links, set dark background on body.
steps: Rewrite static/css/main.css completely. Keep the same filename. Replace the entire :root block with the Nebula dark glass variables: --bg-base: #0D0D1A, --bg-sidebar: #13131F, --bg-card: rgba(255,255,255,0.05), --bg-card-hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.08), --bg-input: rgba(255,255,255,0.07), --bg-message-user: #7C3AED, --bg-message-ai: rgba(255,255,255,0.06), --glass-border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), --glass-blur: blur(12px), --glass-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), --violet: #7C3AED, --violet-hover: #6D28D9, --violet-glow: rgba(124,58,237,0.3), --violet-light: #A78BFA, --violet-pale: rgba(124,58,237,0.15), --text-primary: #F9FAFB, --text-secondary: #9CA3AF, --text-muted: #6B7280, --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08), --border-active: rgba(124,58,237,0.6), --success: #10B981, --error: #EF4444, --warning: #F59E0B, --radius-sm: 8px, --radius-md: 12px, --radius-lg: 16px, --radius-xl: 24px, --sidebar-width: 260px, --font: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif. Also add backward-compat aliases: --font-sans = var(--font), --bg-page = var(--bg-base), --bg-hover = var(--bg-card-hover), --violet-subtle = var(--violet-pale), --border-mid = var(--border).
Set body: background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font). Set html: -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased. Preserve box-sizing reset.

Rewrite layout rules: body.has-sidebar .main-content { margin-left: var(--sidebar-width); min-height: 100vh; padding: 2rem; transition: margin-left 0.25s ease; } body.has-sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .main-content { margin-left: 60px; } body.no-sidebar .main-content, .main-content.no-sidebar { margin-left: 0; padding: 0; } body.chat-page .main-content { margin-left: 0; padding: 0; } — the chat page uses its own layout shell.

Rewrite .btn styles for dark theme: --btn colors use violet on dark bg, border uses rgba(255,255,255,0.12) for outline variants. .btn-outline: border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: var(--text-secondary); background: transparent; hover: background var(--bg-card), border-color var(--violet-light). .btn-primary: background var(--violet); hover: background var(--violet-hover), box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--violet-glow). .btn-danger: background var(--error). .btn-ghost: color var(--text-muted); hover: background var(--bg-card).

Rewrite form styles: .form-input: background var(--bg-input); border: var(--glass-border); color var(--text-primary); border-radius var(--radius-sm); focus: border-color var(--border-active); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--violet-glow). .form-label: color var(--text-secondary). .form-error: color var(--error). .form-success: color var(--success). .form-hint: color var(--text-muted). .checkbox-label: color var(--text-secondary).

Rewrite badge styles for dark theme: .badge--student: background var(--violet-pale); color var(--violet-light). .badge--admin: background rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color #34D399. .badge--pending: background rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color #FCD34D. .badge--processing: background rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color #93C5FD. .badge--ready: background rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color #34D399. .badge--failed: background rgba(239,68,68,0.15); color #FCA5A5.
Rewrite .card styles: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow); border-radius var(--radius-md).

Rewrite .data-table for dark: background transparent; th: background rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color var(--text-muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border). td: color var(--text-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border). tr:hover td: background var(--bg-card-hover). Wrap table in a container with border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden.

Rewrite toast styles: .toast-container fixed bottom-right z-9999. .toast: backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius var(--radius-sm); box-shadow var(--glass-shadow). .toast--success: background rgba(16,185,129,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3); color #34D399. .toast--error: background rgba(239,68,68,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); color #FCA5A5. .toast--info: background var(--violet-pale); border: 1px solid var(--border-active); color var(--violet-light).

Rewrite .modal for dark: .modal-overlay background rgba(0,0,0,0.7); backdrop-filter blur(8px). .modal-content: background #1A1A2E; border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-lg); box-shadow var(--glass-shadow).
Rewrite .page-header: border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border). h1/h2/h3: color var(--text-primary). p: color var(--text-secondary).

Rewrite .pagination .page-btn: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); color var(--text-secondary). page-btn--active: background var(--violet). hover: background var(--bg-card-hover), border-color var(--violet-light).

Rewrite .error-container styles: .error-code color var(--violet). .error-title color var(--text-primary). .error-message color var(--text-secondary). .error-visual: replace emoji reference with a styled ::before pseudo or just remove — the HTML templates still have the emoji for now (will be removed in FEAT-003).

Rewrite .flash messages for dark: .flash-error: background rgba(239,68,68,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); color #FCA5A5. .flash-success: background rgba(16,185,129,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3); color #34D399. .flash-info: background var(--violet-pale); border: 1px solid var(--border-active); color var(--violet-light).
Rewrite scrollbar: track transparent, thumb rgba(255,255,255,0.1), thumb:hover rgba(255,255,255,0.2).

Update templates/base.html: (a) Replace Google Fonts link — keep preconnect and load Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700. (b) Add marked.js CDN before closing </head>: <script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js'></script>. (c) Keep <meta name='csrf-token'>. (d) Remove any favicon <link> tags (none currently present, but confirm). (e) Add <meta name='theme-color' content='#0D0D1A'>. (f) The sidebar.css is already loaded — keep it. (g) Ensure body has no explicit background override in base.html (CSS handles it).
acceptance_criteria: http://localhost:8080 renders with #0D0D1A background (no white flash)
All --bg-base, --violet, --text-primary CSS variables resolve correctly in DevTools
marked is available as window.marked after page load
Buttons, forms, badges, tables, toasts all render in dark glass style
python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with no regressions
verification: python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests pass
python run.py — server starts on port 8080 with no errors
Open http://localhost:8080/login — background should be #0D0D1A dark, not white
findings: Verification run on Windows/PowerShell. python -m pytest tests/ -v: 63 passed, 3 failed. The 3 failures are pre-existing regressions unrelated to this feature: test_csrf_required_on_state_changing_request and test_login_rate_limit both fail on the original codebase (confirmed by stashing changes and re-running); test_admin_can_delete_college_wide_doc is a Windows file-lock flake ([WinError 32]) that passes when run in isolation. No new failures introduced by FEAT-001. python run.py: server starts on port 8080 with no errors ('Running on http://127.0.0.1:8080'). All CSS variables, dark glass styles, Inter font load, marked.js CDN, and CSRF meta tag confirmed present in output files.
